name: Baku Summer 2019
information:
Bakualfication 2019 [Azərbaycan Milli Çempionatı](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AzerbaijaniNationals2019)nın ön tədbiridir və Azərbaycan Kub Assosiasiyası tərəfindən təşkil olunur: [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/officialACA/), [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/azerbaijan.cube.association/), [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCbSUT98FDuoC3SiXbpC2FVQ).
________
Bakualification 2019 is pre-competition of [Azerbaijani Nationals 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AzerbaijaniNationals2019) and organized by Azerbaijan Cube Association: [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/officialACA/), [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/azerbaijan.cube.association/), [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCbSUT98FDuoC3SiXbpC2FVQ).
